body:
## What this listing is

This is Localrent's car hire page for Egypt. Localrent lists cars from local rental companies, so the choice depends on who is active in the country. The page shows 20 cars when we searched, with a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 4,509 reviews, which is Localrent's figure for the whole service.

## What the filters showed

The page's filters gave these counts for Egypt:

- No deposit: 6 cars
- Free cancellation: 7
- Full insurance: 6
- City delivery: 14
- New cars under 5 years: 17
- Real photos: 2
- Low deposit under 300$: 6
- No credit card needed: 20

The counts change with your dates and pick-up point, so run your own search to see what is available.

## A sample price

The lowest-priced car we saw was a Nissan Sunny, 21.53$ per day or 301.42$ for 14 days, a new automatic car with a 2,100 km limit and instant booking, with no deposit. These prices are for the dates we searched and for one car model, so they are a guide, not a quote.

## What else the page says

Every one of the twenty cars needs no credit card, and fourteen offer city delivery. Each car card also shows its cover: minimum and basic cover are free of charge on many listings, while full cover is available at an extra daily charge on some and unavailable on others.

## What to check

Look at the mileage limit, because some cars carry a daily cap and others state unlimited mileage. Check the deposit and the cancellation terms on the specific car, since they differ from one local company to another. Localrent shows photos for only some cars, so read the description before you book.

## When it fits

It suits a driving trip where you want an automatic car delivered in the city and no card deposit. If you need a pick-up outside the places Localrent lists, compare it with the other providers on this site's car rental page.
